test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Hyderabad : Telangana :: Gangtok : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** First word is the capital city of the second word.

 
• Hyderabad : Telangana → Telangana is the capital city of Hyderabad.

Similarly,

 
• Gangtok : ? → Gangtok is the capital city of Sikkim.

Hence, '**Sikkim**' is the correct answer.
